description: Defines the Store2 class implementing IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces, providing gRPC-based secure storage operations, including setting, getting, deleting values and namespaces, with internal notification management and environment-based configuration.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing secure storage via gRPC, managing environment configs, notifications, and system state checks.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Inner class for dispatching value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes gRPC stub with environment-based URI and credentials.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks system time synchronization status, optionally via system manager if WITH_SYSMGR is defined.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves current authentication token via IAuthService interface.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for value changes.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in secure storage with optional TTL, notifies listeners on success.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL from secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Associates the Store2 instance with a service shell.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered listeners of a value change.
